scope: October same-session developmental percussion-duration relative magnitude experiment. First 8 hits design, final 5 held from new fit; prior EQ saw this session. No IR or phase inversion.

rules.gates: Common KM184 onset through maximum three-device observed tail, 40ms below peak -35dB/local quiet +6dB; 0.83s cap. 5ms edge taper, no full Hann that suppresses attack.
rules.resolution: 1/12 octave only where physical band width >=3/event duration; zero-padding does not create resolution. Joint raw SNR >=10dB, relevance weights, >=4/8 design-hit support and sign/MAD shrinkage.
rules.gain: One 200–600Hz gain learned on 8 design hits from latest output, frozen for both filters and all held hits.
rules.filter: Frozen latest 1/12 filter plus one 600–12k relative-EQ supplement; section -6/+4dB, total supplement absolute cap6dB, causal IIR. Under600Hz held approximately constant.
rules.selection: One candidate, no held-hit tuning or refitting; developmental comparison, not independent recording validation.
rules.limitation: Magnitude EQ cannot reconstruct phase, spatial radiation or decay differences. Gate detects acoustic energy, not verified hand-contact duration.
